critical_code_review_comments: routes_v2.py::delete_job_role correctly clears users.role_id via db.users.update_one before deleting the job_role row — but uses update_one which only nulls the FIRST matching user. If multiple users share the same role_id this will leave dangling references. Consider db.users.update_many (or equivalent). Spec test still passes because seed has only one worker with that role at delete time.

routes_v2.py::update_standard_item handles area_id/role_id/activity_id/document_type_id='' → None correctly using model_dump(exclude_unset=True), preserving the 'clear scope' contract documented in the request.
server.py::UserUpdate exposes role_id and update_user persists it; GET /api/users returns the field (verified via integration test).
Frontend AdminLayout.js: 'Importar Trabajadores' has been removed from sidebar as required; 'Cargos' was added under Personas group.
